designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1990 with more than 93,000 acres donated through The Conservation Fund and the Richard King Mellon Foundation, combined with the adjacent Pungo National Wildlife Refuge (1963).

authority.citation: Land donation to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Pocosin Lakes National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS Pocosin Lakes NWR tearsheet: refuge "established in 1990" with lands donated by The Conservation Fund and the Richard King Mellon Foundation; combined with Pungo Refuge (established 1963)

review.note: The about-us sentence (1984) does not match FWS's own refuge publication, which gives 1990. Note Pungo NWR (1963), now part of the refuge, is older; confirm whether the directory should date the refuge from Pungo.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1984 to protect the rare pocosin wetlands and their associated wildlife.
